newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Forint ends little weaker vs dlr in sporadic trade.
newsitem.headline: Forint ends little weaker vs dlr in sporadic trade.

text.p: 1225 GMT - The Hungarian forint closed the midday session a shade weaker against the dollar in what dealers called a "dead market."
* The forint closed at 169.22/27 to the dollar, compared to its opening level of 169.05/10.
* The Hungarian currency traded ten to fifteen pips weaker than the central bank's bid level.
* The National Bank of Hungary fixed its middle rate against the dollar at 169.11.
